## 12.  
Powers to extend the time-limit of one year will be exercised by the Administrative Ministries/Departments with the approval of the FA  
concerned, in individual cases attendant with special circumstances.  
- GIO (2), SR 148.
6. The concession is not admissible to families of -
- (a)
- Employees who die while on leave preparatory to retirement;
- (b)
- Retired employees who are re-employed; and
- (c) Temporary employees who have not rendered three years of
- continuous service. - GIO (1), SR 148.
